newsitem.title: UK: VLCC Soro resumes voyage to Canada after repairs.
newsitem.headline: VLCC Soro resumes voyage to Canada after repairs.

text.p: The very large crude carrier Soro, which was damaged by a freak wave in the Atlantic when it was en route to Canada, resumed its voyage on Tuesday after undergoing full repairs, a spokesman for the ship's agents said.
The Soro is laden with 283,793 tonnes of Norwegian crude which it is taking to Port Tupper, said the spokesman for Maritime Navigation Company.
The 299,718 dwt, 1993-built vessel sustained damage to its steering gear when it was hit by the freak wave last week.
